sources.label: Unofficial Morphe patches for ServusTV On and ORF on
sources.author: AT TV Patches (unofficial)
patch_list: Makes the 'Update required' dialog dismissible, so the patched app can't be locked out by a forced update.
Stops ÖWA/INFOnline reach measurement, GfK video measurement, Bitmovin player analytics and Sentry crash reporting from starting.
Removes pre-roll and post-roll ads from videos, live channels and timeshift.
Skips the cookie consent banner and saves 'Disagree to all' instead, as if you declined it. The privacy settings in the app stay available.
